scenes.vo: Is this website safe to type your password into? Check for one tiny thing.

scenes.title: HTTP vs HTTPS
scenes.vo: HTTP is like sending a postcard. Anyone along the way can read it. HTTPS is a sealed envelope. Only the website can open it.

right.name: HTTPS
right.point: Only the website can open it

scenes.title: ENCRYPTION
scenes.vo: Your password gets scrambled before it leaves your phone, so a hacker in the middle only sees gibberish.

scenes.title: THE RULE
scenes.vo: Before you type a password or card number, check for the padlock and https in the address bar.

items.text: and https:// in the address bar

scenes.vo: Follow for more tech, made simple.
